mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.code,c.name,c.exam_system,c.specialty,c.level,c.enabled FROM study_target t JOIN certificate c ON c.id=t.certificate_id WHERE t.user_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_target VALUES(#{userId},#{certificateId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM study_target WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND certificate_id=#{certificateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO learning_record(user_id,entity_id,version,favorite,wrong,progress) VALUES(#{userId},#{entityId},#{version},#{favorite},#{wrong},#{progress}) ON CONFLICT(user_id,entity_id) DO UPDATE SET version=excluded.version,favorite=excluded.favorite,wrong=excluded.wrong,progress=excluded.progress,updated_at=now()
mapper.select: SELECT l.user_id,l.entity_id,l.version,l.favorite,l.wrong,l.progress,l.updated_at,v.title FROM learning_record l JOIN content_version v ON v.entity_id=l.entity_id AND v.version=l.version WHERE l.user_id=#{id} ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT l.user_id,l.entity_id,l.version,l.favorite,l.wrong,l.progress,l.updated_at,v.title FROM learning_record l JOIN content_version v ON v.entity_id=l.entity_id AND v.version=l.version WHERE l.user_id=#{id}) page_count
